APPLICATION DEADLINES AND REQUIREMENTS
Each program at the Graduate Center determines its own requirements for admission. Use the list below to confirm deadlines for fall and spring enrollment, standardized testing requirements (international students may have to take the TOEFL iBT or IELTS), and any additional requirements your intended program may have set. Note that all deadlines are 11:59PM EST on the date listed.
MASTER'S AND DOCTORAL PROGRAMS CERTIFICATE PROGRAMS
The majority of Graduate Center programs (including all of our Ph.D. programs) only accept students in the fall semester. The master’s programs in Data Analysis and Visualization, Data Science, Digital Humanities, Liberal Studies, Middle Eastern Studies, and Nanoscience are the only programs to accept applications for the spring semester.
APPLICATION DEADLINES AND REQUIREMENTS - MASTER'S AND DOCTORAL PROGRAMS
Please visit the website for your program of interest for further detailed requirements and information on the application review process.

**NYSED-Approved Licensed Health Professions Programs
To be admitted or advance into a NYSED-approved licensed health professions program in fall 2020 and beyond, students must provide documentation for one of the categories listed here. Namely, applicants may demonstrate eligibility through documents that verify that they: 1) are U.S. citizens, 2) have legal permanent resident status, or 3) are in another eligible category set forth in the policy, generally through presentation of an employment authorization document. This document from U.S. Citizen and Immigration Services is useful: List of Documents that Establish Identity and Employment Authorization.
